title: A mixed-methods study evaluating the innovative, modular treatment approach of the Flex-Day Clinic at the LVR-Clinic Langenfeld in comparison to the established treatment approach of the Day Clinic in the department of General Psychiatry III at the LVR-Clinic Langenfeld
summary:
Against the backdrop of a tension between a shortage of care and the need to treat people with mental illness, the staff at the LVR-Clinic in Langenfeld developed a partial inpatient treatment concept centered on a modular system. The goal is to provide cost-effective treatment for patients that is tailored to their specific needs and requirements, in order to avoid both over- and under-treatment. Since this modular and flexible partial inpatient concept is novel in Germany, there is a lack of scientific evidence regarding it. The study aims to examine and evaluate the new day clinic concept in comparison to a day clinic at the LVR-Clinic Langenfeld with an established therapeutic approach, thereby gaining new scientific insights that can lead, in a subsequent step, to the optimization and expansion of day clinic care for patients. The project is a prospective study conducted by the LVR-Clinic in Langenfeld. It employs a mixed-methods design that combines quantitative and qualitative research questions. 
The survey instruments used are listed in the description of the study protocol.
conditions: all psychiatric diagnoses from ICD-10 F20 to F60

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
The sample is recruited from the newly opened Flex Day Clinic. The comparison sample is recruited from the day clinic of the Department of General Psychiatry III, which has an established treatment program. The study includes patients of any gender who are being treated at the Flex-Day Clinic or the Day Clinic of the Department of General Psychiatry III at the LVR Clinic in Langenfeld due to a mental illness.
In addition, the following inclusion criteria have been established:
- Primary diagnosis for the current treatment: ICD-10 F2* to F6*
 - Good command of the German language
- Written consent to participate in the study
Exclusion criteria:
The following exclusion criteria were established for participation in this study:
- A primary diagnosis in the areas of substance use disorders (ICD-10 F1*) or dementia (ICD-10 F0*)
- Unwillingness on the part of participants to personally undergo the interviews or complete the rating scales
- Severe cognitive deficits
- Participants under legal guardianship
